$comment: Corrections under DR-0036. A correction makes a schema match what the published text of the major already says. Each entry names a schema location by document and JSON pointer, the change it allows, the stable release it lands in, the source text it rests on (a repository path and a quote from it), and the reason. The additive-minor check accepts exactly these changes. A PR that adds an entry is reviewed against DR-0036, which states the rule and does not list entries.
